answer.outline: A GET to each supported route returns the expected result; an unknown resource returns a 404; unsupported methods return 405.
suggested_steps: Start with one route and verify it before adding parameters.
Use a typed converter for integer IDs and keep endpoint names unique.
Use the test client to verify status codes as well as body text.
